findings.title: Vectorization technical requirement has no corresponding task or verification step
findings.description: The slice design's Technical Requirements state: *"Both forces are vectorized within each agent's neighborhood — no nested Python loops."* No task in the breakdown asserts or verifies this. Tasks 3.1 and 4.1 prescribe the per-algorithm math in scalar-looking notation (e.g., 4.1's `sum(velocity[i] * leadership[i]) / sum(leadership)` with per-neighbor indexing), which a junior implementer could easily translate into a Python loop over neighbors — exactly what the requirement forbids. The test tasks (3.2, 4.2) check numerical results only, not implementation shape. Add a step to 3.1/4.1 (e.g., "aggregate neighbors with fancy indexing / `np` vectorized ops, no Python loop over neighbors") and a verification line in 6.1 or the relevant test task confirming the neighborhood aggregation is vectorized.

findings.title: No task creates or verifies the slice branch
findings.description: CLAUDE.md requires verifying/creating the slice branch (`102-herding-and-leadership`) from `main` before starting slice work, and the frontmatter's `projectState` says "Branch to be created from main" — but no task step covers branch setup or verification before the first commit in task 1.3. Adding one checklist line under Section 1 (or as a Section 0) would close this.
